note: Bull / base / bear, written AFTER the verdicts as the pre-registration allows, under its one rule: every indicator is a quantity this pipeline already computes, so a reader can re-run them next month. Levels are analyst-chosen trigger points, not measurements, and live here so every document quotes the same ones. No price targets anywhere.
disclaimer: This is research, not investment advice.

cases.name: bull
cases.stance: the shift becomes numerator-driven and starts paying the token

indicators.confirms: three consecutive rising months, robust across the grid
indicators.kills: a new low below the current trough

indicators.confirms: share rising while native transfers are flat or growing - the strong, numerator-driven form
indicators.kills: share rising only while native transfers keep falling

indicators.confirms: any month above the pre-registered 10% materiality bar
indicators.kills: the ratio staying below 2% for two more quarters

indicators.watch: a documented Intents fee path to NEAR holders (H5b)
indicators.confirms: a primary source naming a burn, distribution or staking mechanism
indicators.kills: another year of fee routing documented only to collectors and integrators

cases.name: base
cases.stance: cross-chain settlement keeps growing on a shrinking native base

indicators.watch: Intents swaps per day (H4 intents leg)
indicators.confirms: continued growth at roughly the measured pace
indicators.kills: two consecutive quarters of declining swaps per day

indicators.confirms: the decline flattening toward zero slope
indicators.kills: re-acceleration past the window's worst monthly fall

cases.name: bear
cases.stance: the native economy keeps contracting and the bridge traffic follows it down

indicators.confirms: monthly falls matching or exceeding the window's average

indicators.watch: Intents swaps per day (H4 intents leg)
indicators.confirms: swaps per day turning down alongside native activity
indicators.kills: swaps per day making a new high

indicators.confirms: new highs - activity collapsing into a handful of contracts
indicators.kills: HHI falling back toward its early-window level
